title: 「Far from being X, Y …」句
titleZh: 「Far from being X, Y …」表達強烈否定與相反結果

source.file: Sentence structure 255 -「Far from being X, Y …」.pdf

The source filename is numbered one lower than this system lesson ID because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Far from being + X, + complete main clause

formulas.formula: Far from being X, + subject + verb.

formulas.labelZh: 放在報告或嵌入子句內
formulas.formula: Subject + reporting verb + that + subject, far from being X, + verb.

meaning.zh: 先強烈否定 X，再用完整主句說明真正情況通常與 X 不同，甚至完全相反。

rules.zh: X 所描述的主語必須和逗號後主句的主語指向同一人物或事物。
rules.en: The subject described by X must refer to the same person or thing as the subject of the following main clause.

rules.zh: Y 必須是包含主語和有限動詞的完整主句，不可只寫不完整短語。
rules.en: Y must be a complete main clause with a subject and a finite verb.

rules.zh: being 後面的形式要完整；名詞短語須保留所需的冠詞，亦可接形容詞、分詞形容詞或較長短語。
rules.en: Use a complete form after being. Retain any required article in a noun phrase; an adjective, participle adjective or longer phrase is also possible.

rules.zh: being 不會因時態改變；時態由主句動詞表達。
rules.en: Being does not change for tense. Express time through the verb in the main clause.

rules.zh: 句首 far from being 短語後使用逗號；作插入語時在前後使用逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after an opening far from being phrase, and use two commas when it is parenthetical.

rules.zh: Far from being 表達強烈否定和修正，語氣比單純 not 更有力。
rules.en: Far from being expresses strong negation and correction, so it is more forceful than a simple not statement.

rules.zh: 不要把目標句型與 is far from perfect、Far from helping 或表示距離的 far from 混合；本練習只使用 far from being + X。
rules.en: Do not confuse the target with is far from perfect, Far from helping or literal distance. This exercise uses only far from being + X.

benefits.zh: 能強烈糾正錯誤印象，清楚指出真正情況。
benefits.en: It strongly corrects a mistaken impression.

benefits.zh: 能在一句內連接被否定的看法和真正事實。
benefits.en: It connects the rejected idea and the truth in one sentence.

benefits.zh: 比普通 but 對比更有力，令結果更突出。
適合說明表面弱點、失敗或缺點如何反而帶來有用結果。
benefits.en: It helps explain how an apparent weakness became useful.

benefits.zh: 可放在整句開首、開首短語後、主語後或嵌入子句內，提供不同組句方法。
benefits.en: It gives you different ways to organise a sentence.

benefits.zh: 適合議論文、報告、簡報、比較和因果分析等說服性及分析性寫作。
benefits.en: It is useful in persuasive and analytical writing.

en: Rewrite each sentence using far from being + X.
Preserve the rejected idea and the contrasting fact. Keep any opening phrase, reporting clause, question or other sentence frame when necessary.
The target expression does not always need to appear at the beginning of the complete answer.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用 far from being + X 改寫以下句子。
保留原句中被否定的看法和與之相反的事實；如有需要，保留開首短語、報告子句、問句或其他句子框架。
目標表達不一定要放在整個答案的句首。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。
